purpose: Freeze the first exact finite language for the minimal auxiliary escalation after v8.4: two hidden Boolean-q wires D,E. This artifact deliberately does not claim a positive or negative fanout result. It defines the state codec and invariants that every v8.5 search, DP quotient, witness verifier, or bounded barrier must use.

bounded_language.candidate_splice_edges: all cross-wire port pairs between distinct wires: C(5,2)*6*6 = 360
bounded_language.port_capacity: matching: each exposed endpoint is used at most once
bounded_language.named_load_bound: load(A),load(B),load(C) <= 3 so each named wire keeps at least three free ports for a minimum direct OR_3 occurrence
bounded_language.total_splice_bound: <= 10 edges from total available fanout incidences 3+3+3+6+6 = 21, hence floor(21/2)=10
bounded_language.source_open_gate: the three initial H paths per wire plus selected splice edges must remain a forest of open paths; any splice joining endpoints already in the same path component closes an H cycle and is illegal
bounded_language.local_semantics: exact v8.2 affine F3 boundary state (c,s,q), q in {+1,-1}
bounded_language.frame_quotient: fix A to (c,s)=(0,+1) by global AGL(1,3)=S3 colour symmetry; enumerate all 6^4 = 1296 frames for B,C,D,E for each q tuple
bounded_language.semantic_mask_width: 1296 frame bits per q tuple, stored as 21 x 64-bit words
bounded_language.hidden_projection: existentially quantify q_D, q_E and the affine frames of D,E

state_codec_obligations: Any checker must generate exactly 360 candidate splice edges over unordered wire pairs and ordered endpoint choices.
Any semantic state must carry 32 q branches and 1296 affine frame possibilities per branch before edge intersections.
Any topology state must enforce matching endpoints and open-path acyclicity, not merely degree bounds.

Any branch prune must be monotone-safe under future edge intersections. The safe mandatory prune is preservation of at least one surviving frame for named +++ and at least one surviving frame for named ---, after existential hidden projection.
A positive witness must be validated by a standalone verifier that recomputes exact masks and source-open topology from the printed edge list.
A negative result must either exhaust this full finite language or prove a sound quotient whose classes refine exact semantics and topology.
not_allowed_as_proof: SAT/SMT black-box models without independent exact replay
orbit-mask intersection that ignores port identities or H-splicing topology
declaring a bounded v8.5 result as a universal P=NP algorithm
hidden exponential boundary tables or unaccounted bitlength/state blowup

next_engine.name: E8_V8_5_TWO_HIDDEN_Q_FANOUT_CODEC_AND_QUOTIENT_SEARCH
next_engine.directive: Prove the state codec and constants first, then implement quotient/DP search. Do not run naive depth-10 brute force over 360 edges without a state quotient.
